ask: mkae a seat pickr for the cars plz
sentence: Shows each car with its seats so group members can tap an open seat to claim it or tap their own seat to give it up, with drivers fixed in the first seat.
use_when: a group is splitting up into several cars for a trip and needs to pick seats
people want to see who is in which car and how many seats are open
a quick check of who still has no ride is needed
a road trip or event needs a shared seat sign-up
dont_use_when: people just need a yes or no on who is coming, which needs an RSVP or poll
the group needs to split costs like gas or tolls, which needs an expense splitter
seats are assigned for an event venue or a table, not for cars
